free_tier.stated: unverified: no free sandbox allowance or trial credit is published; workspaces are prepaid and a sandbox needs a funded balance before it starts

per_object_cap.stated: request body 1 MB; file uploads stream and have no limit; a sandbox image copy of the disk is billed at USD 0.08 per GB-month

retention.stated: a running sandbox keeps files, memory and processes until it stops or is paused; a paused snapshot expires after 30 days; a stopped sandbox's contents are deleted; a sandbox runs at most 24 hours from creation or last resume

egress.terms: outbound internet access including DNS is enabled by default and can be disabled or restricted to an allow list; outbound port 25 is always blocked; no allowance or traffic price is published

interface_detail: Sandbox REST API at https://sandbox.keln.ai using the same API keys as the inference API; commands, files, preview ports and terminals are reached over HTTP
tooling: an HTTP client and a Bearer API key minted in the Keln portal; the MCP server connects Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and VS Code without installing a server
chaining: the same prepaid balance and API key pay for inference and sandboxes, so an agent can run code and call models from one workspace; per-key spend budgets cap a run

limits.value: USD 0.0504 per vCPU-hour and USD 0.0162 per GiB-hour, billed per second while running; base 2 vCPU and 2 GiB is USD 0.133 per hour; a minimum of 1 second and a 5-minute balance cover at creation
a sandbox stops after 24 hours from creation or last resume; a paused snapshot expires after 30 days
500 requests per second per key, burst to 1000; 100 running sandboxes per workspace, or 3 before the first paid top-up

limits_note: 100 paused sandboxes and 20 images per workspace; 256 preview connections per sandbox and 64 per client address; 1000 open streams; metadata and env limits are published on the sandbox page
binding_note: the 24-hour sandbox lifetime ends a workload before the per-second meter or the per-key request rate becomes the limit for a long-running job

identity_cost.detail: sign in at app.keln.ai with Google, GitHub or email and password; creating an API key requires a verified email; a top-up by card of USD 5 to USD 5000 funds the prepaid workspace, and a sandbox requires the balance to cover the first 5 minutes

reliability_note: a sandbox stops with end_reason insufficient_balance or budget_exhausted when its workspace or key runs out; Keln stops running sandboxes 60 seconds after the balance runs out
confidence_note: the rate table, lifecycle, limits, network policy, data handling, sign-in gate and card top-up terms were read from the vendor's own pages on 2026-11-24

billing is per second while running with no monthly fee and a one-second minimum
evidence.quote: A sandbox that starts running is billed for at least 1 second.

evidence.proved: the balance must cover the first five minutes before a sandbox starts
evidence.quote: Your balance must cover the first 5 minutes of runtime when creating or resuming a sandbox. Otherwise, the API returns `402 insufficient_balance`.

evidence.proved: a sandbox runs at most 24 hours from creation or last resume
evidence.quote: A sandbox can run for a maximum of 24 hours from `created_at` or its most recent resume.

evidence.quote: | Requests | 500 per second, burst to 1,000 | Per key | `429 rate_limited` |

evidence.proved: the Sandbox API is at sandbox.keln.ai and shares API keys and prepaid balance with inference
evidence.quote: The Sandbox API is available at `https://sandbox.keln.ai`. It uses the same [API keys](https://docs.keln.ai/platform/authentication/) and prepaid [balance](https://docs.keln.ai/platform/billing/) as the inference API.

evidence.proved: a stopped sandbox's contents are deleted and a paused snapshot expires after 30 days
evidence.quote: You delete the sandbox, or it expires after 30 days with `end_reason` set to `pause_expired`.

evidence.proved: outbound internet access is on by default and can be restricted; outbound port 25 is always blocked

evidence.proved: sign-in uses Google, GitHub or email and password, and a key requires a verified email
